sources.count: an engine choice (AET-WO-4411 D4): 2 x 2, one at each crossing of the 3 x 3 land pattern's gaps; ESP32-C3-WROOM-02 datasheet v1.7 p. 37, Figure 11-1 draws 12, one in each gap between neighbouring lands, as KiCad's footprint did at 0.2 mm on a 0.55 mm pitch, which the engine's 0.3 mm drill cannot keep apart
sources.pitch: an engine choice (AET-WO-4411, ruled 2026-11-25T21:17Z (c)): 1.125 mm, 18 of the supply gate's 62.5 um cells, so all four vias sit on its grid once the pad's centre does; p. 37, Figure 11-1 draws the land pattern's gap crossings at a 1.1 mm pitch (0.7 mm pads, 0.4 mm gaps), and each via sits 12.5 um per axis outward of its crossing, inside the fabricator's +/-50.8 um hole position (OSH Park, the declared board.stackup.fab_tolerances.hole_position_um)
sources.drill: the engine's via drill, 0.3 mm (AET-WO-4411 D4, ruled: vias at the engine's drill); the datasheet states none
sources.ring: the engine's via ring for a 0.3 mm drill in a 0.6 mm pad; the datasheet states none
sources.layers: p. 37, Figure 11-1: vias for the thermal pad, which is ground (pin 19); to the ground fill on every copper layer, an engine choice: no layer is stated

area_at.section: p. 37, Figure 11-1: the antenna area, 18 mm wide and 6 mm deep at the module's top edge (the module 18 x 20 mm)

clearance_at.section: PDF p. 26 (printed 23), Figure 21: a clearance area of Min 15 mm left of, right of and above the antenna

feed_at.section: p. 34, Figure 10-1 top view: the antenna trace meets the module's body at its right end, and Figure 10-2 puts the -02U's u.FL connector at the top right (the builder's reading of the drawings), so HDG-C3 Figure 19 (feed point on the right) applies; 3.0 mm from the body's right side to the board's right edge, an engine choice: the figure draws it at the edge without a dimension, and the engine keeps 2 mm beyond the 0.75 mm courtyard

placement_at.section: PDF p. 24 (printed 21), §1.4.7 and Figure 19, position 3 (strongly recommended): the PCB antenna outside the base board, the module at the corner with its feed point (right) at the edge
